samples.summary: cli.md's per-command safety table is now out of step with the registry it documents: the 7 new registry entries (docs.copy, docs.move, folders.list|create|rename|move|delete) have no rows, although every other namespace including images.* and files.* is enumerated there.
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:1586-1594 lists `docs.list` … `docs.set-content` and 1654-1667 lists `files.*`, `images.*`, `login`, `ctx.*`; grepping cli.md for "| `docs.copy", "| `docs.move" and "folders." returns only the prose link at cli.md:569. Meanwhile packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts:137,148,555,564,575,586,598 add those seven commands, and the rest of the docs (rest-api.md:489-511, packages/backend/README.md:626-629, cli.md:545-571, packages/cli/README.md:118) were updated. The fix belongs in the docs table, not in the new code.
searchedFor: grep folders docs/design/rest-api.md, packages/backend/README.md, docs/design/workspace-folders.md, docs/design/agentic-office-workflow.md

samples.summary: The new `folderId` on the v1 documents PATCH is unvalidated: the body is an inline type, so the global ValidationPipe skips it, unlike the web route that reaches the same operation through `UpdateDocumentDto` (@IsUUID). A malformed id reaches Prisma inside `assertSameWorkspace` and surfaces as a 500 rather than a 400.
samples.evidence: packages/backend/src/main.ts:65-70 registers a global `ValidationPipe({whitelist:true, forbidNonWhitelisted:true})`, which only takes effect when the body's metatype is a DTO class; documents.controller.ts:115 declares `@Body() body: { title?: string; folderId?: string | null }`, so nothing validates it and `this.folderService.assertSameWorkspace(body.folderId, workspaceId)` (documents.controller.ts:146) runs `prisma.folder.findUnique({where:{id: <arbitrary string>}})` against a uuid column (folder.service.ts:75-78). The sibling web path validates first (packages/backend/src/document/document.dto.ts `UpdateDocumentDto`, used at document.controller.ts:348), and the new folders controller does use DTOs (folders.controller.ts:116), which leaves this route the odd one out.
